Kings Point Capital Management Stake in Amgen (AMGN) Has Upped as Share Value Declined; Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Rand Wealth Has Lowered Its Stake as Market Value Rose
June 17, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Kings Point Capital Management increased its stake in Amgen Inc (AMGN) by 12.68% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kings Point Capital Management bought 2,237 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.44% with the market. The institutional investor held 19,874 shares of the biological products (no diagnostic substances) company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.39 million, up from 17,637 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kings Point Capital Management who had been investing in Amgen Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $122.42 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.42% or $0.78 during the last trading session, reaching $185.01. About 3.17M shares traded. Amgen Inc. (NASDAQ:AMGN) has risen 14.68% since June 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.11% the S&P500. Rand Wealth Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 4.59% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rand Wealth Llc sold 3,306 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 68,728 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $11.53 million, down from 72,034 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rand Wealth Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $928.18 billion market cap company.
